description: Enrich up to 25 people in ONE call — the canonical follow-up to search_person. Pass each search result's person_id as a record; the matched.identifier in the response equals that person_id so you can stitch results back to the original list. Per-record cost is identical to enrich_person (1 credit per matched email, 10 per matched email+mobile). Response also includes free_enrichment per record so you can attribute credit consumption. Returns a compact response per record (no job_history, no skills, abbreviated company summary) — use enrich_person if you need the full profile for a specific person. For >25 records, call this multiple times — do not auto-batch.

inputSchema.description: Enrich up to 25 people in one call — the canonical follow-up to search_person. Pass each search result's person_id as a record; the matched.identifier in the response will equal that person_id so you can stitch results back to the original list. When records come from outside Prospeo (e.g. scraped names, CRM rows), pass EVERY identifier you have per record — first_name + last_name + full_name + company_name + company_website + company_linkedin_url + linkedin_url all together — rather than the bare minimum. Same per-record credit cost as enrich_person. Returns a compact response per record (no job_history, no skills, abbreviated company summary) — use enrich_person if you need the full profile for a specific person.

data.description: Up to 25 person records to enrich in a single request.

items.description: Pass EVERY identifier you have for this person — more fields means higher match rate. If you have a LinkedIn URL, still send name + company alongside it; if you have a name + company, send first_name + last_name + full_name + company_name + company_website + company_linkedin_url together. Minimum to attempt a match: linkedin_url, email, person_id, OR (first_name+last_name / full_name) + (company_name / company_website / company_linkedin_url).

full_name.description: Person's full name (alternative to first_name + last_name)

identifier.description: Optional correlation key returned with this record's result. Defaults to person_id when provided, otherwise an index-based id (idx-0, idx-1, ...).

person_id.description: Prospeo person_id from a prior Search Person result

enrich_mobile.description: Also look up mobile numbers (10 credits per matched record; email is included at no extra cost).

only_verified_email.description: Only return records where a verified email is found. Applies to every record in `data`.

only_verified_mobile.description: Only return records where a verified mobile is found (automatically enables enrich_mobile).

name: bulk_enrich_person
